defaultPrompt: What screenshots did I save this week?
Find my saved links and addresses
interface.longDescription: Shotbox is a privacy-first screenshot action engine. It reads the text in your screenshots on-device, extracts useful details like links, prices, addresses, and OTPs, and organizes everything into smart buckets. This plugin lets you search your processed screenshots, browse your buckets, get item details with extracted entities, and view your usage stats — all without your images ever leaving your device.

name: shotbox
description: Search your Shotbox screenshot library — find items, browse buckets, and view stats. All data stays on your device; only metadata syncs.
